lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The schedule is void. Not because I argued it, because I read it, and it cites a subsection that was struck at committee and never reinstated.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Four years of drafting and the useful skill turned out to be reading. Nobody reads them. That is the whole profession.

lines.speaker: fence_moro
lines.text: Eleven stalls. You can have anything on mine you like and I will be insulted if you pay.
